Martinet's engravings for the Oiseaux series were groundbreaking in their attention to anatomical detail and color fidelity, and are still widely collected by ornithologists, decorators, and natural history enthusiasts. The print is in excellent condition with fresh, unfaded original hand-coloring. A wonderful example of French Enlightenment-era natural history illustration.
